action_params.error_message: AP determined agent is stuck — no viable actions remain
action_params.summary:
The automation assumed that tapping Download would always show a system prompt. The screen instead remained in the app's download state, and the workflow had no alternate path for that state, so it kept waiting until no further action was possible.
Update the automation to handle both paths: accept the system prompt when it appears, or monitor the in-app status for Ready when it does not. Add a bounded timeout and report an inconclusive environment/setup issue rather than remaining stuck.
action_params.one_liner: The run got stuck waiting for a system prompt that never became available instead of recognizing the available language-download state or ending with a bounded timeout.
